records.jp: 詩帆さんがいると、<CR>本当にここがカフェになったみたい
records.en_original: It really feels like an actual cafe with you here, Shiho.
records.en_auxiliary: It really feels like an actual cafe with you here, Shiho.
records.en: It really feels like an<CR>actual cafe with you here, Shiho-san.

records.jp: コーヒーと紅茶、どちらにしますか？
records.en_original: Would you like coffee or tea?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you like coffee or tea?
records.en: Would you like coffee or tea?

records.jp: コーヒーがいいな
records.en_original: Coffee sounds good.
records.en_auxiliary: Coffee sounds good.
records.en: Coffee sounds good.

records.jp: 好きな豆はありますか？
records.en_original: Do you have a preferred bean?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you have a preferred bean?
records.en: Do you have a preferred bean?

records.jp: 豆はよくわかんないけど、<CR>あまりクセがなくて飲みやすいやつがいいな
records.en_original: I don't know much about coffee beans... I guess just something that's easy to drink.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know much about coffee beans... I guess just something that's easy to drink.
records.en: I don't know much about coffee<CR>beans... I guess just something that's easy to drink.

records.jp: 了解です。せっかくなので、<CR>前に使ったのとは違う豆をブレンドしますね
records.en_original: Certainly. I'll make you a fresh blend.
records.en_auxiliary: Certainly. I'll make you a fresh blend.
records.en: Understood. Since we have the opportunity,<CR>I'll blend different beans from the ones I used before.

records.jp: 紅茶でお願いします
records.en_original: I'd like tea, please.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd like tea, please.
records.en: I'd like tea, please.

records.jp: 飲み方はどうします？
records.en_original: How would you like it?
records.en_auxiliary: How would you like it?
records.en: How would you like it served?

records.jp: ミルクで
records.en_original: With milk.
records.en_auxiliary: With milk.
records.en: With milk.

records.jp: わかりました
records.en_original: Certainly.
records.en_auxiliary: Certainly.
records.en: Certainly.

records.jp: うちの喫茶店、紅茶にも力入れてたんです。<CR>とっておきの一杯を淹れますね
records.en_original: We are quite confident in our teas here. I'll brew you one of our finest.
records.en_auxiliary: We are quite confident in our teas here. I'll brew you one of our finest.
records.en: Our café put a lot of effort into tea as well.<CR>I'll brew you an exceptional cup.

records.jp: うま……<CR>ミルクと砂糖くらいしか入れてないのに
records.en_original: Oh, yum... It's great with just a bit of milk and sugar.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, yum... It's great with just a bit of milk and sugar.
records.en: Oh, yum...<CR>It's great with just a bit of milk and sugar.

records.jp: きちんと手順を踏んで、本来の味を引き出してあげれば<CR>特別なものを入れなくても充分美味しくできるんです
records.en_original: By following the proper steps and bringing out the flavors, it can be enjoyed even without adding anything.
records.en_auxiliary: By following the proper steps and bringing out the flavors, it can be enjoyed even without adding anything.
records.en: If you follow the proper steps and draw out its natural flavor,<CR>you can make it delicious without adding anything special.

records.jp: とはいえ、トッピングやアレンジを考えるのも、<CR>それはそれで楽しいんですけどね
records.en_original: Though it is still fun to think about different things to add and variations.
records.en_auxiliary: Though it is still fun to think about different things to add and variations.
records.en: Though it is still fun to think about different<CR>things to add and variations.

records.jp: 今までどんなメニューを考えたの？
records.en_original: What kinds of drinks have you come up with so far?
records.en_auxiliary: What kinds of drinks have you come up with so far?
records.en: What kinds of drinks have you come up with so far?

records.jp: フローズンコーヒーに、<CR>ホイップクリームと砕いたナッツを載せて
records.en_original: Frozen coffee topped with whipped cream and crushed nuts.
records.en_auxiliary: Frozen coffee topped with whipped cream and crushed nuts.
records.en: Frozen coffee topped<CR>with whipped cream and crushed nuts.

records.jp: 最後にラム酒入りシロップを一回し
records.en_original: Finished off with a dash of rum syrup.
records.en_auxiliary: Finished off with a dash of rum syrup.
records.en: Finished off with a dash of rum syrup.

records.jp: わお、大人
records.en_original: Whoa, sounds classy.
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa, sounds classy.
records.en: Whoa, sounds classy.

records.jp: ただ、お母さんに味見してもらったんですけど……<CR>ラム酒のアルコールが結構残ってたみたいで
records.en_original: I had my mother try it for me, but she was quite upset with me.
records.en_auxiliary: I had my mother try it for me, but she was quite upset with me.
records.en: I had Mom taste it, but...<CR>apparently quite a bit of the rum’s alcohol remained.

records.jp: 自分で味見できないものを作るのは<CR>早いって言われちゃいました
records.en_original: She told me not to make things I won't be able to taste myself.
records.en_auxiliary: She told me not to make things I won't be able to taste myself.
records.en: She told me not to make things I<CR>won't be able to taste myself.

records.jp: あはは。<CR>いつか飲んでみたいなぁ
records.en_original: Ahaha. I'd love to give it a try sometime.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha. I'd love to give it a try sometime.
records.en: Ahaha. I'd<CR>love to give it a try sometime.

records.jp: ラテアートは？　余計なものはそんなに加えずに<CR>アレンジの楽しさも味わえそうな気がするけど
records.en_original: What about latte art? That way you can play with different variations without affecting the flavor.
records.en_auxiliary: What about latte art? That way you can play with different variations without affecting the flavor.
records.en: What about latte art? That way you can play with<CR>different variations without affecting the flavor.

records.jp: 挑戦したことはあります
records.en_original: I've actually tried a little bit.
records.en_auxiliary: I've actually tried a little bit.
records.en: I've actually tried a little bit.

records.jp: でも、凝りすぎてお客さんに出すのに時間が<CR>かかってしまって、禁止されちゃいました
records.en_original: But I took so long, by the time I served the drink it was cold. They told me not to do it anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: But I took so long, by the time I served the drink it was cold. They told me not to do it anymore.
records.en: But I became so elaborate that serving customers took too long,<CR>so they forbade me from doing it.

records.jp: またやってみたいなとは思ってるんですけどね
records.en_original: Though I would like to try it again sometime.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I would like to try it again sometime.
records.en: Though I would like to try it again sometime.

records.jp: 見てみたいなぁ。詩帆さんの力作
records.en_original: I'd love to see what you can do.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd love to see what you can do.
records.en: I'd love to see your masterpiece, Shiho-san.

records.jp: お時間のある時に声をかけてもらえば、作りますよ
records.en_original: Just let me know when you have a little time and I'd be happy to make it for you.
records.en_auxiliary: Just let me know when you have a little time and I'd be happy to make it for you.
records.en: Just let me know when you have a little time and I'd be happy to make it for you.

records.jp: やった。楽しみ～
records.en_original: All right! I can't wait!
records.en_auxiliary: All right! I can't wait!
records.en: All right! I can't wait!

records.jp: いやぁ、でも本当に美味しいよ。これ
records.en_original: This tasted amazing.
records.en_auxiliary: This tasted amazing.
records.en: This tasted amazing.

records.jp: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいです。<CR>本当にここでカフェ開いちゃおうかな
records.en_original: I'm so happy to hear you say that. Maybe I should really open up a cafe here.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so happy to hear you say that. Maybe I should really open up a cafe here.
records.en: I'm so happy to hear you say that.<CR>Maybe I should really open up a cafe here.

records.jp: 星崎さんは飲みもの以外だったら、<CR>どんなメニューが欲しいですか？
records.en_original: What would you like to see on the menu other than drinks if I did?
records.en_auxiliary: What would you like to see on the menu other than drinks if I did?
records.en: Besides drinks, what kind of food<CR>would you want on the menu, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: ナポリタン食べたい
records.en_original: Spaghetti sounds great.
records.en_auxiliary: Spaghetti sounds great.
records.en: I want Napolitan.

records.jp: ナポリタン……！
records.en_original: Spaghetti?!
records.en_auxiliary: Spaghetti?!
records.en: Napolitan...!

records.jp: え、どうかした？
records.en_original: What's wrong?
records.en_auxiliary: What's wrong?
records.en: What's wrong?

records.jp: 簡単に見えて本当に美味しく作るのが<CR>難しいパスタなんですよ……
records.en_original: It may seem like a simple dish, but it's actually very difficult to get right...
records.en_auxiliary: It may seem like a simple dish, but it's actually very difficult to get right...
records.en: Napolitan may look simple, but it's one of those pasta dishes<CR>that's surprisingly hard to make really well...

records.jp: そうなんだ。<CR>私でも作れそうだなーって思ってたけど
records.en_original: Oh... I always thought it was so easy even I could make it.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh... I always thought it was so easy even I could make it.
records.en: Oh... I always<CR>thought it was so easy even I could make it.

records.jp: 頑張って練習して美味しいナポリタン<CR>出せるようにしますね！
records.en_original: I'll start practicing my spaghetti technique right away!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll start practicing my spaghetti technique right away!
records.en: I'll practice hard so I can serve you<CR>delicious Napolitan!

records.jp: （理想が高いんだろうなあ。<CR>やっぱり料理に対する情熱がすごいや）
records.en_original: (I bet Shiho's standards are sky high. She really is passionate about food.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I bet Shiho's standards are sky high. She really is passionate about food.)
records.en: (I bet Shiho's standards are sky<CR>high. She really is passionate about food.)

records.jp: ちょっとめんどいかもしれないんだけど<CR>アフタヌーンティーセットとかいける？
records.en_original: It might be kind of tough, but maybe something like an afternoon tea set?
records.en_auxiliary: It might be kind of tough, but maybe something like an afternoon tea set?
records.en: It might be kind of tough, but maybe<CR>something like an afternoon tea set?

records.jp: えっと、お皿が三段になってる……
records.en_original: Hm... Those three tier snack trays?
records.en_auxiliary: Hm... Those three tier snack trays?
records.en: Hm... Those three tier snack trays?

records.jp: そうそう。あれで優雅にお茶飲んでみたいなって。<CR>準備手伝うからさ、一回やってみることってできる？
records.en_original: Yeah! That way we could have a fancy tea party. And maybe I could help prepare it?
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! That way we could have a fancy tea party. And maybe I could help prepare it?
records.en: Yeah! That way we could have a fancy tea<CR>party. And maybe I could help prepare it?

records.jp: 実はわたしも憧れてたんです！　あのかわいい<CR>一口サイズのお菓子、いっぱい作って並べたいなって
records.en_original: I've always wanted to do that! We could fill it with lots of little bite-sized treats.
records.en_auxiliary: I've always wanted to do that! We could fill it with lots of little bite-sized treats.
records.en: I have dreamed of that too! I want to make and arrange<CR>lots of those adorable bite-sized sweets.

records.jp: さっそくレシピ考えますね！<CR>何載せようかな～♪
records.en_original: I'll think of some recipes! I wonder what would be good...
records.en_auxiliary: I'll think of some recipes! I wonder what would be good...
records.en: I'll think of some recipes! I wonder<CR>what would be good...

records.jp: （やっぱ詩帆さん興味あったか。<CR>提案してみてよかった）
records.en_original: (I had a feeling she'd like that idea. Glad I brought it up.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I had a feeling she'd like that idea. Glad I brought it up.)
records.en: (I knew Shiho-san was interested.<CR>I'm glad I suggested it.)
